summary: Real Racine County campground booked on the county's WebReserv page: $35 weeknights / $40 weekends, 19 sites of which nine take an RV (25-60 ft, two 50-amp pull-throughs). Not waterfront confirmed; pin fine; stored 45-ft max -> 60 ft; season left as stored (county page unread, sources disagree).
